label: hotpot_split
units: pp of gain; weights per model (ties share places)
rule: Split pilot. Pilots: the item-disjoint 100-item one-draw pilots of the strict decision design (one discovery draw and 100 items from the pilot half of the items each; 200 pilots), as saved. In each pilot, the 100 items are assigned half to requested direct and half to forced direct by numpy.random.default_rng(20261121): an array of uniform draws of shape (pilots, strata, items per stratum) is drawn once, each row of the last axis is argsorted, and the positions whose argsort value is below half the stratum's items (floor) are requested, the rest forced (one stratum of 100 items where there are no strata; BIG-Bench Hard: 25 tasks of 4 items in the pilot's task order). The same assignment holds for every model of a pilot. A model's predicted gain is 100 x the mean over the 100 items of (chain-of-thought score minus the score of the baseline the item was assigned to), strict scoring. The top third (src/decision.third_size: round(M / 3), 10 of 29) by predicted gain gets chain of thought; models within estimators.TIE_TOL (1e-9 pp) of the cut share the remaining places equally (src/decision.choose). The two single-baseline pilots are the strict design's own-gain choices from the same pilots (100 calls on the requested or the forced arm). Regret: src/decision.regret_plugin, pp of gain per chosen model, averaged over the pilots, under each deployment baseline (gains over the requested arm; over the forced arm), on the evaluation half of the items and the validation configurations absent from every discovery draw, each once. Worst regret: the larger of the two deployment regrets.
statement: Primary outcome: the split pilot's worst regret (the larger of its requested-deployment and forced-deployment regrets) against the worst regret of the better single-baseline pilot (whichever of the requested-only and forced-only pilots has the smaller worst regret, chosen with hindsight), valued on HotpotQA's validation configurations absent from every discovery draw (each once), on the evaluation half of the items, strict exact match. The statement: the split pilot's worst regret is lower. Both component regrets of every policy are reported, with the paired differences and their t intervals over evaluation configurations; all distinct validation configurations and leave-one-family-out are reported beside it. Equal worst regrets are reported as equal, and the statement as not holding.
note: read only HotpotQA discovery-draw outputs and the strict design's saved discovery file; written before any validation draw was scored. The split pilot was found by exploratory analysis on GSM8K, MATH-500 and BIG-Bench Hard (results/split_pilot/); this is its forward test.
